points.statement: The approach converts a coordination object into an executable commitment to a skill path.
points.quote: GenCoord turns that object into an executable skill-path commitment.

points.statement: Coordination needs to expose the task consequence of a private fact, including actor, handoff item, destination, and following suffix.
points.quote: Coordination must reveal the task consequence of a private fact: who acts, what crosses the handoff boundary, where it goes, and which suffix follows.

points.statement: The resolved commitment is parsed, checked, canonically materialized, compiled to skills, and verified via handoff and terminal state.
points.quote: The resolved commitment is parsed, checked, canonically materialized, compiled to Mineflayer skills, and verified by handoff and terminal state.

points.statement: A local model emits a plan and a peer request, while bounded feedback routes revision when the deciding capability belongs to the peer.
points.quote: A local Qwen3.5-0.8B model emits a multi-step SELF plan and peer REQ; bounded feedback conditions route revision when the deciding capability is peer-local.

points.statement: In the main forward route, the receiving agent uses the request and produces its own downstream path.
points.quote: In the main forward route, the receiver conditions on REQ and generates its downstream SELF path.

points.statement: A capability consequence local to the peer returns via bounded feedback, after which the requester changes the division of work.
points.quote: A peer-local capability consequence travels back through bounded feedback, after which the requester revises the division of work.

points.statement: Both directions rely on a single explicit object whose meaning survives communication, resolution, and execution.
points.quote: Both directions require one explicit object whose semantics survive communication, resolution, and execution.
